# Test fixture provenance
- `cube.obj`, `cube.mtl`, PNG maps, `cube.ply`, `cube.stl`, `plane.gltf`, `plane.bin`, `plane.glb`, and `nested-obj.zip`: synthetic fixtures created for these tests.
- `animation-only.glb`: mesh-free derivative of Quaternius' CC0 Animated Human; see `../../src/assets/WORKER_LICENSE.txt`.
- `draco/`: Cesium Box, CC BY 4.0; see its attribution and license files.
- `ktx/`: modified Flight Helmet, CC0; see attribution and license files.
- STEP, IGES and BREP automated tests use samples already provided by the separately installed `occt-import-js` npm package; those sample assets are not redistributed here.
- No Adobe Mixamo assets or account credentials are included. The optional Mixamo test accepts a user-supplied local FBX through `MIXAMO_FIXTURE`.
